Topics · One God, one message

Is there one God behind all the names?

Many names, one One, says the Quran. What remains without names: one, needing nothing, unborn, without equal.

Part 1 of 3

﴿قُلِ ٱدْعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ أَوِ ٱدْعُوا۟ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنَ ۖ أَيًّا مَّا تَدْعُوا۟ فَلَهُ ٱلْأَسْمَآءُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ ۚ وَلَا تَجْهَرْ بِصَلَاتِكَ وَلَا تُخَافِتْ بِهَا وَٱبْتَغِ بَيْنَ ذَٰلِكَ سَبِيلًا﴾

Translation of the meaning

Say, "Call upon Allāh or call upon the Most Merciful [ar-Raḥmān]. Whichever [name] you call - to Him belong the best names." And do not recite [too] loudly in your prayer or [too] quietly but seek between that an [intermediate] way.

Quran · Al-Isra 17:110

Translation

Give thanks to Yahweh! Call on his name! Make his doings known among the peoples. Sing to him, sing praises to him! Tell of all his marvelous works. Glory in his holy name. Let the heart of those who seek Yahweh rejoice.

Original · Hebrew

הוֹד֣וּ לַ֭יהוָה קִרְא֣וּ בִּשְׁמ֑וֹ הוֹדִ֥יעוּ בָ֝עַמִּ֗ים עֲלִילוֹתָֽיו׃ שִֽׁירוּ־ל֭וֹ זַמְּרוּ־ל֑וֹ שִׂ֝֗יחוּ בְּכָל־נִפְלְאוֹתָֽיו׃ הִֽ֭תְהַלְלוּ בְּשֵׁ֣ם קָדְשׁ֑וֹ יִ֝שְׂמַ֗ח לֵ֤ב ׀ מְבַקְשֵׁ֬י יְהוָֽה׃

the Psalms · 105:1-3

World English Bible

You begin from something many wise people have said: the names differ, the One does not. That claim does not make the names false, and it does not make the One a matter of taste. It says the names point past themselves. This verse agrees on this much: call by one name or by another, and the finest names all belong to the one who is called. So the question is not which name wins. It is what the names point at.

A question for you

When the names have all fallen away, what do you picture is left?

If you saySilence, with nothing left to say
ThenMany contemplatives would sit there with you. The verses ahead do not argue with the silence. They add a few words about what the silence is not.
If you sayThe same One that every name points to
ThenThen the question becomes what can truly be said of that One. The next verses say four things, short enough to hold in one breath.
If you sayI can't picture anything
ThenThat is a straight answer, and an old one. The next verses do not ask for a picture. They ask which words survive when pictures do not.

Part 2 of 3

﴿بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ هُوَ ٱللَّهُ أَحَدٌ١ ٱللَّهُ ٱلصَّمَدُ٢ لَمْ يَلِدْ وَلَمْ يُولَدْ٣ وَلَمْ يَكُن لَّهُۥ كُفُوًا أَحَدٌۢ٤﴾

Translation of the meaning

Say, "He is Allāh, [who is] One,[2011] Allāh, the Eternal Refuge.[2012] He neither begets nor is born, Nor is there to Him any equivalent."

Translator's notes

[2011] Alone, without another, indivisible with absolute and permanent unity and distinct from all else. The one and only true deity, unique in His essence, attributes and deeds.

[2012] He who is absolute, perfect, complete, essential, self-sufficient and sufficient to meet the needs of all creation; the one eternally and constantly required and sought, depended upon by all existence and to whom all matters will ultimately return.

Quran · Al-Ikhlas 112:1-4

Translation

Yahweh will be King over all the earth. In that day Yahweh will be one, and his name one.

Original · Hebrew

וְהָיָ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה לְמֶ֖לֶךְ עַל־כָּל־הָאָ֑רֶץ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֗וּא יִהְיֶ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה אֶחָ֖ד וּשְׁמ֥וֹ אֶחָֽד׃

Zechariah · 14:9

World English Bible

Take away every name and image, and ask what must still be true of the One. Four things are said, each small enough to test. One: single, not one among several. Two: needing nothing, while everything needs it. Three: not born and not giving birth, so there is no beginning to trace. Four: no equal anywhere. Most of these say what the One is not, which is why they can be held without a picture.

A question for you

Which of the four is hardest to say of anything inside the world?

If you sayOne, with no second
ThenEverything in the world has company and parts. If this is true of the One, it is true in a way nothing else can share. The fourth line returns to it.
If you sayNeeding nothing
ThenEverything we can name depends on something else; even the sun needs fuel. The verse says this One alone does not.
If you sayNot born and not giving birth
ThenReaders from different traditions meet this line in different ways. The next verse takes up the word “like”.
If you sayNothing equal to it
ThenThis leads straight on: if nothing is its equal, no name or picture is a copy of it. That is the subject of the next verse.

Part 3 of 3

﴿فَاطِرُ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ جَعَلَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَٰجًا وَمِنَ ٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ أَزْوَٰجًا ۖ يَذْرَؤُكُمْ فِيهِ ۚ لَيْسَ كَمِثْلِهِۦ شَىْءٌ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْبَصِيرُ﴾

Translation of the meaning

[He is] Creator of the heavens and the earth. He has made for you from yourselves, mates, and among the cattle, mates; He multiplies you thereby. There is nothing like unto Him,[1411] and He is the Hearing, the Seeing.[1412]

Translator's notes

[1411] There is no similarity whatsoever between the Creator and His creation in essence, in attributes or in deed. [1412] See footnotes to 17:1.

Quran · Ash-Shura 42:11

Translation

To whom then will you liken God? Or what likeness will you compare to him? “To whom then will you liken me? Who is my equal?” says the Holy One.

Original · Hebrew

וְאֶל־מִ֖י תְּדַמְּי֣וּן אֵ֑ל וּמַה־דְּמ֖וּת תַּ֥עַרְכוּ לֽוֹ׃ וְאֶל־מִ֥י תְדַמְּי֖וּנִי וְאֶשְׁוֶ֑ה יֹאמַ֖ר קָדֽוֹשׁ׃

Isaiah · 40:18, 25

World English Bible

If nothing is like the One, then no name, picture or thought is a copy of it. That is the wisdom of the traditions that approach the One by saying what it is not: every “is” we add risks making it a thing among things. The verse also ends by saying the One hears and sees. Not like anything, and not absent: neither a distant idea nor an item in the world.

A question for you

Which way of speaking about the One is closer to your own practice?

If you sayPraise, by many names
ThenThe first verse gives the finest names to the One who is called. All the verses ask is that every name stays a name of that One.
If you sayDenial: not this, not this
ThenThis verse begins the same way, then adds what the denial leaves standing: the One hears and sees.
If you saySilence
ThenSilence is a way too. The verse offers two words to take into it, hearing and seeing, and nothing more.

The same in the other books

Now therefore, Yahweh our God, save us, I beg you, out of his hand, that all the kingdoms of the earth may know that you, Yahweh, are God alone.”

the Torah (Exodus) · 9:14
